A promise to Grandma

Read here, then choose what Pip says or does.

On an earlier visit, Grandma had given Pip a lantern seed. They had promised to plant it together before dark today. Pip put the seed in his backpack and set off for her garden.

Last night's storm had washed away the footbridge. At the river, Pip stopped and took out Grandma's letter. She had written it before the storm.

"Mara and Sol hardly visit anymore. I think they don't enjoy coming to the garden now. I miss hearing their stories."

You are Pip · Explore, talk and help

Reach Grandma’s garden and plant the seed together.

Story so far

Pip promised to plant a lantern seed with Grandma. The storm washed away the footbridge.

Pip is on the dock side of the river. The two wooden bridge sections are separate. Dock-side end not fastened. Garden-side end not fastened. The separate seed boat is by the dock-side bank. The seed is in Pip's backpack. Mara has her page. Visit Rina at the bakery. Water is dripping through a cracked roof tile.

Making your way

Click a place to walk there, or use WASD and the arrow keys. Approach a person, then choose Talk or press E.

In Arrange bridge, drag a section or select it and click where it should go. The same Move and Turn buttons work without dragging.
